40022859.author: पदार्थः
40022859.content: वर्तमाने while going on, तथाभूते being such, यज्ञे in the sacrifice, च and, परमाद्भुते supremely wonderful, सशिष्यः with disciples, आजगाम came, आशु quickly, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages.

40022859.author: Translation
40022859.content: While that supremely wonderful sacrifice was thus going on, Valmiki, the foremost among sages, quickly arrived with his disciples.

40022860.author: पदार्थः
40022860.content: सः he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दिव्यसङ्काशम् divine-like, यज्ञम् the sacrifice, अद्भुतदर्शनम् wondrous to behold, एकान्ते in a secluded place, ऋषिवाटानाम् of the hermitages of sages, चकार made, उटजान् huts, शुभान् auspicious.

40022860.author: Translation
40022860.content: Having seen the divine-like and wondrous sacrifice, he (Valmiki) constructed auspicious huts in a secluded spot among the hermitages of other sages.

40022861.author: पदार्थः
40022861.content: शकटान् carts, च and, बहून् many, पूर्णान् full, फलमूलैः with fruits and roots, च and, शोभनान् excellent, वाल्मीकिवाटे in Valmiki's hermitage, रुचिरे charming, स्थापयन् placing, अविदूरतः not far off.

40022861.author: Translation
40022861.content: He also had many carts, full of excellent fruits and roots, placed not far off in his charming hermitage.

40022862.author: पदार्थः
40022862.content: आसीत् was, सुपूजितः well-honored, राज्ञा by the king, मुनिभिः by sages, च and, महात्मभिः by great-souled ones, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, सुमहातेजा of great splendor, न्यवसत् resided, परमात्मवान् self-controlled.

40022862.author: Translation
40022862.content: Valmiki, of great splendor and self-controlled, was greatly honored by the king and the great-souled sages, and thus he resided there.

40022863.author: पदार्थः
40022863.content: सः He, शिष्यौ to his two disciples, अब्रवीत् said, हृष्टौ delighted, युवाम् you two, गत्वा having gone, समाहितौ concentrated, कृत्स्नम् entire, रामायणम् Ramayana, काव्यम् epic poem, गायेथाम् you two should sing, परया with supreme, मुदा joy.

40022863.author: Translation
40022863.content: Valmiki, delighted, instructed his two disciples to go and sing the entire epic poem of Ramayana with utmost concentration and joy.

40022864.author: पदार्थः
40022864.content: ऋषिवाटेषु in hermitages of sages, पुण्येषु sacred, ब्राह्मणावसथेषु in abodes of Brahmins, च and, रथ्यासु in streets, राजमार्गेषु in royal highways, पार्थिवानाम् of kings, गृहेषु in houses, च and.

40022864.author: Translation
40022864.content: They were to sing in sacred hermitages of sages, in the homes of Brahmins, in streets, on royal highways, and in the palaces of kings.

40022865.author: पदार्थः
40022865.content: रामस्य of Rama, भवनद्वारि at the palace gate, यत्र where, कर्म rituals, च and, कुर्वते they perform, ऋत्विजाम् of priests, अग्रतः in front, च and, एव indeed, तत्र there, गेयम् it should be sung, विशेषतः especially.

40022865.author: Translation
40022865.content: They should sing especially at Rama's palace gate, where rituals are performed, and in front of the priests.

40022866.author: पदार्थः
40022866.content: इमानि these, च and, फलानि fruits, अत्र here, स्वादूनि delicious, विविधानि various, च and, जातानि grown, पर्वताग्रेषु on mountain peaks, च and, आस्वाद्य having tasted, आस्वाद्य repeatedly tasted, गायताम् let them sing.

40022866.author: Translation
40022866.content: While singing, they should repeatedly taste these various delicious fruits that grow on the mountain peaks.

40022867.author: पदार्थः
40022867.content: न not, यास्यथः you two will experience, श्रमम् fatigue, वत्सौ O dear children, भक्षयित्वा having eaten, फलानि fruits, वै indeed, मूलानि roots, च and, सुमृष्टानि very clean/delicious, नगरात् from the city, बहिः outside, आस्यथः you two will stay/be.

40022867.author: Translation
40022867.content: O dear children, you two will not experience fatigue by eating fruits and pure roots, and you will stay outside the city.

40022868.author: पदार्थः
40022868.content: यदि if, शब्दापयेत् calls, रामः Rama, श्रवणाय for listening, महीपतिः the king, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, उपविष्टानाम् who are seated, ततः then, गेयम् the song, प्रवर्तताम् let it proceed.

40022868.author: Translation
40022868.content: If King Rama calls for the sages to listen, then the singing should begin.

40022869.author: पदार्थः
40022869.content: दिवसे in a day, विंशतिः twenty, सर्गाः cantos, गेयाः should be sung, मधुरया with sweet, गिरा voice, प्रमाणैः with measures, बहुभिः many, तत्र there, यथोद्दिष्टाः as instructed, मया by me, पुरा previously.

40022869.author: Translation
40022869.content: Twenty cantos should be sung daily with a sweet voice, using the many meters and measures as I have previously instructed.

40022870.author: पदार्थः
40022870.content: लोभः greed, च and, अपि also, न not, कर्तव्यः should be done, स्वल्पः even a little, अपि even, धनकाङ्क्षया with desire for wealth, किम् what use, धनेन with wealth, आश्रमस्थानाम् for those living in hermitages, फलमूलोपजीविनाम् who subsist on fruits and roots.

40022870.author: Translation
40022870.content: Do not show even a little greed for wealth, for what use is wealth to those who live in hermitages and subsist on fruits and roots?

40022871.author: पदार्थः
40022871.content: यदि if, पृच्छेत् asks, सः he, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), युवाम् you two, कस्य whose, इति thus, दारकौ boys, आवाम् we two, वाल्मीकिशिष्यौ disciples of Valmiki, स्वः are, ब्रूतम् say, एवम् thus, नराधिपम् to the king.

40022871.author: Translation
40022871.content: If Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, asks, "Whose boys are you two?", then tell the king, "We are the disciples of Valmiki."

40022872.author: पदार्थः
40022872.content: इमाः these, तन्त्रीः strings, सुमधुराः very sweet, स्थानम् notes/pitch, वा or, अपूर्वदर्शनम् unprecedented to see/hear, मूर्च्छयित्वा having tuned/harmonized, सुमधुरम् very sweetly, गायतम् sing, विगतज्वरौ free from anxiety.

40022872.author: Translation
40022872.content: Harmonize these very sweet strings or notes in an unprecedented manner, and sing very sweetly, free from any anxiety.

40022873.author: पदार्थः
40022873.content: आदिप्रभृति from the beginning, गेयं to be sung, स्यात् should be, न not, च and, अवज्ञाय disrespecting, पार्थिवम् the king, पिता father, हि indeed, सर्वभूतानां of all beings, राजा the king, भविति is, धर्मतः by dharma.

40022873.author: Translation
40022873.content: The Ramayana should be sung from the beginning, and the king should not be disrespected, for a king is indeed the father of all beings by virtue of dharma.

40022874.author: पदार्थः
40022874.content: तत् therefore, युवां you two, हृष्टमनसौ with joyful minds, श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते in the morning, समास्थितौ having taken your seats, गायेथां you two should sing, मधुरं sweet, गेयं song, तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् accompanied by string instruments and rhythm.

40022874.author: Translation
40022874.content: Therefore, you two, with joyful minds, should take your seats tomorrow morning and sing the sweet song, accompanied by string instruments and rhythm.

40022875.author: पदार्थः
40022875.content: इति thus, सन्दिश्य having instructed, बहुशः repeatedly, मुनिः the sage, प्राचेतसः son of Prachetas, तदा then, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, परमोदारः most noble, तूष्णीम् silently, आसीत् remained, महायशाः highly renowned.

40022875.author: Translation
40022875.content: Thus, having repeatedly instructed them, the highly renowned and most noble sage Valmiki, son of Prachetas, then remained silent.

40022876.author: पदार्थः
40022876.content: सन्दिष्टौ having been instructed, मुनिना by the sage, तेन by him, तौ those two, उभौ both, मैथिलीसुतौ sons of Maithili, तथैव just so, करवाव we shall do, इति thus, निर्जग्मतुः they departed, अरिन्दमौ subduers of enemies.

40022876.author: Translation
40022876.content: Having been instructed by that sage, both sons of Maithili, those subduers of enemies, departed, saying, "We shall do just so."

40022877.author: पदार्थः
40022877.content: ताम् that, अद्भुतां wonderful, तौ those two, हृदये in their hearts, कुमारौ the princes, निवेश्य having placed, वाणीम् words, ऋषिभाषितां spoken by the sage, तदा then, समुत्सुकौ very eager, तौ those two, सममूषतुः they passed, निशां the night, यथा just as, अश्विनौ the Ashvins, भार्गवनीतिसंहिताम् (the night) associated with the wisdom of Bhargava.

40022877.author: Translation
40022877.content: Then, those two princes, having fixed those wonderful words spoken by the sage in their hearts, passed the night with great eagerness, just as the Ashvins awaited the wisdom of Bhargava. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 93 ।। Thus ends the ninety-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
